headline: UI/UX Designer
summary: Architectural drafter of four years now working as a UI/UX designer. I learned Figma and user research through a design bootcamp and have spent the past year designing app and website screens for startups. My drafting background gives me a strong sense of layout, grids and precise detail.
skills: UI design for web and mobile

experience.title: UI/UX Designer
bullets: Design screens and clickable prototypes in Figma for a farm inputs ordering app and two websites.
Run short usability tests with farmers and store owners and fix what confuses them.
Build and maintain the app's component library with the developers.

experience.title: Architectural Drafter
